data.title: CRUD
data.tagline: CRUD is the four basic operations repeatedly performed on one kind of data: create, read, update, and delete.
data.learningOutcome: You can split a tool idea into "which parts are CRUD and which are extra features," and scope the request to an AI Agent with these four words.
data.description: For a client quote list: tapping "new" adds a quote (create), opening the list shows every record (read), changing an amount or status is an update, and removing a record is a delete. These four cover the backbone of managing data; exports and charts are extra features built on top, not one of the four.

learning.assumes: You have used a notes or spreadsheet app and know list content can be added and edited.
learning.outcome: You can split a tool idea into "which parts are CRUD and which are extra features," and scope the request to an AI Agent with these four words.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.explanation: CRUD names the four operations on data; Database is one place where the data can live.

distinctions.label: Form
distinctions.explanation: Form is the interface used to complete create and update; CRUD is the full set of data operations behind it.

explanation.title: Create and Read
explanation.text: Create adds a record: fill in client and amount, save, and a new row appears. Read shows the records: list and detail pages are reads, and so are filtering and searching.

explanation.title: Update
explanation.text: Change information in an existing record. Editing amount or status updates; it creates no new record.

explanation.title: Delete
explanation.text: Remove a record. Deletion usually deserves a confirmation because it is often irreversible.

data.boundary: CRUD names the operations, not the storage location—the data can live in browser storage or a cloud database while the operations stay the same. Login, exports, and analytics are not CRUD: they are permission concerns or features built on top of the data. Scope a request with these four words and the AI will not balloon the tool.

lessonPractice.title: An AI says "the CRUD for the quote tool is done." Which feature below is NOT one of those four operations?

options.label: Exporting quotes into a monthly chart
options.feedback: Correct. Exporting and reporting are extra features built on top of the data. The four basic operations only manage each record itself.

options.label: Changing a quote's status from "following up" to "won"
options.feedback: That is Update: modifying information in an existing record.

options.label: Removing a quote record that is no longer needed
options.feedback: That is Delete: removing an existing record.

data.agentPrompt: Build a client quote list with complete CRUD: create a quote, read the full list, update amount and status per row, and delete rows. Keep the data in browser storage for now. Skip charts this round.
